name: Fly Meta
description: Air Atlanta Europe's 747-400 freighters flown for Fly Meta (飛元時代): all white, with 'Fly Meta' in sky-blue rounded lowercase over the forward main deck and '飛元時代' in the same blue under it; on the white fin the Fly Meta mark, a sky-blue ribbon folded into a large triangular loop above a small one. White engines.

sources.title: 9H-WFF Boeing 747-446(BDSF) Fly Meta MST 19.3.26 (55194815633).jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, Colin Cooke Photo)
sources.note: 747-400(BDSF) 9H-WFF, right side nearly level at Maastricht, 2026-03-19 (Commons date 2026-04-08). Flipped and fitted to shapes/B744-passenger.json (outline landmarks; within 10 px): the titles' ends and heights, the fin mark's place and size, the mark on the right winglet.

sources.title: 9H-FLM Boeing 747-409F Fly Meta MST 19.3.26 (55194815648).jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0, Colin Cooke Photo)
sources.note: 747-400F 9H-FLM, left side from ahead at Maastricht, 2026-03-19 (Commons date 2026-04-08): the same layout on the left, the mark mirrored (sloping up toward the tail on both sides), the left winglet bare grey. Too oblique to fit; used by eye.

titles.style: Rounded geometric sans in sky blue, capital F and M with lowercase, over the forward main deck behind the upper deck's windows; the y's tail drops below the baseline.
The Chinese name in the same blue, a plain sans (hei) style, under 'Meta' and ending with it (the aft end of the title block on the left); a small dot between 飛 and 元.
As on the left, but under the forward word: on the right 'Meta' is forward, and the Chinese sits under it, ending at the block's forward end.

logos.description: Fly Meta's mark: a single sky-blue ribbon of even width folded into a large, roughly triangular loop with its sharp point at the top trailing corner, crossing down into a smaller triangular loop beneath it, the whole about 0.7 as wide as tall. Mirrored on the right (it sweeps up toward the tail on both sides).
The same mark, small, on the right winglet's outer face (9H-WFF).

notes: Measured on 9H-WFF's right side (the left from 9H-FLM is too oblique to fit): 'Fly Meta' runs x 0.178-0.324 (12.2-22.2 m back) with its capitals 2.0 m tall, its baseline 0.8 m above the centreline; '飛元時代' sits under 'Meta' on both sides: x 0.182-0.275 on the right (measured), 0.231-0.324 on the left (placed to end with 'Meta', as 9H-FLM shows; not fitted). The fin mark is about 7 m tall, centred 65.9 m back and 8.4 m up. 9H-FLM is a factory 747-400F (short upper deck), 9H-WFF a converted -400 (long upper deck): the titles sit at the same place on both. Winglets: 9H-WFF's right one is white with the mark; 9H-FLM's left one looks bare grey and unmarked, so the winglets' colour is left out and the winglet mark is drawn on the right only. Until early 2026 9H-FLM kept its former owner's blue belly cheatline under the Fly Meta titles (Commons 2024-11-27, 2025-02-08); the March 2026 photos show it repainted all white. Colours by eye.
